item.title: Women’s Para Ice Hockey Ruled Out for 2026 Winter Paralympics, Targets 2030
item.description: Women's para ice hockey will not appear at the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy, with the sport targeting inclusion at the 2030 Games. The post Women’s Para Ice Hockey Ruled Out for 2026 Winter Paralympics, Targets 2030 appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Arike Ogunbowale Arrested at Miami Nightclub After Winning Unrivaled Championship

item.title: Record 160 Women’s Sports Athletes Set to Compete at 2026 Winter Paralympics
